data.desc: EUDA Health Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: EUDA) is a Singapore-based distributor of third-party wellness and non-invasive healthcare products and services in Singapore, Malaysia and China. The Company aims to become a market leading distributor of non-invasive and preventive healthcare, with a strategic focus on the fast-growing longevity sector. Our mission is to address the evolving healthcare needs of over 1.8 billion people across the region which is experiencing significant demographic shifts as more than 30% of the population ages rapidly. By facilitating access to innovative, accessible, and science-backed third-party wellness and non-invasive healthcare products and services, EUDA is positioned to help with the transformation of regional healthcare from reactive medical treatment to proactive, longevity-focused care. EUDA also runs a Singapore-based property management business.
